title: CHARUSAT National Tech Fest & Hackathon 2026
description: Annual national-level 24-hour hackathon with tracks in Web Development, AI/ML, Cloud Computing, and Cybersecurity. Exciting cash prizes and internship offers.

title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule - Semester 3 & 4
description: Official mid-term examination timetable for all B.Tech engineering branches. Students must carry valid university identity cards and exam admit slips.

title: Hands-on Workshop on Cloud Computing & Kubernetes
description: Interactive technical workshop covering Docker containerization, Kubernetes cluster orchestration, and Google Cloud deployment workflows.

title: AI & Generative Deep Learning Bootcamp
description: Deep dive into Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and building multimodal AI applications.

title: Annual Inter-College Sports Meet - Spardha 2026
description: Annual university sports tournament featuring Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Athletics, and indoor games. Trophies for winning college departments.

title: Campus Placement Drive & Internship Fair 2026
description: Recruitment drive by leading IT companies and MNCs for software engineering, cloud architecture, QA engineering, and product analyst roles.

title: Annual Cultural Festival - Vrund 2026
description: Grand cultural evening celebrating music, drama, traditional dance performances, fashion walk, and live musical concert by renowned artists.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Hands-on Training
description: Practical session on web application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), penetration testing techniques, packet sniffing, and defensive security measures.

title: Web Development Frameworks Lab Practical Evaluation
description: Continuous evaluation and code walkthrough for semester laboratory practicals, covering semantic HTML5, CSS Grid/Flexbox, DOM, and Fetch API.

title: Alumni Mentorship & Higher Education Webinar
description: Interactive panel discussion with alumni working at top global tech firms, sharing guidance on GRE/TOEFL preparation, MS admissions, and tech careers.

title: Cross-Platform Mobile App Development with Flutter
description: Step-by-step masterclass on building responsive Android and iOS apps using Flutter and Dart, including REST API integration and state management.

title: Final Year Capstone Project Innovation Fair
description: Showcase of innovative multidisciplinary engineering prototypes and software solutions evaluated by industry experts and academic judges.

title: University Table Tennis & Badminton Championship
description: Singles and doubles knockout tournament for undergraduate and postgraduate students. Certificates and medals for winners and runners-up.

title: End-Semester Examination Hall Ticket & Seating Plan
description: Eligible students with minimum 80% attendance can generate and download digital examination hall tickets for university end-semester exams.

title: Open Source Contribution & Git/GitHub Masterclass
description: Hands-on guide to version control, branching strategies, creating pull requests, writing clean documentation, and participating in global open source events.

title: IoT & Embedded Systems Robotics Showcase
description: Line-follower robots, autonomous drones, smart agriculture IoT devices, and home automation systems demonstration by student engineering teams.

title: Annual Blood Donation & Community Health Camp
description: Voluntary blood donation camp organized in collaboration with Red Cross Society. Free general health checkup and donor certificate provided.

title: Student Startup & Innovation Pitch Competition
description: Present early-stage startup ideas to angel investors and industry leaders. Seed funding grants and incubation mentorship available for winning teams.
